handoffs.task: Categorize and set priority for ticket t011: a 12-person team wants to see who edited a note and when (version history with names), and cannot tell who deleted a paragraph. They say they would pay extra for this.

changed.findings: Lumen's ticket data does not show whether it offers edit attribution or deletion audit logs. Two other tickets mention a version history and edit history, so some form of note history appears to exist, but no ticket says whether it shows who made each change. t055 asks for an audit trail export and t011 is the only ticket on this request, and none of the tickets say which plan or add-on would include these features. The read tools have no product or pricing catalog, so plan and add-on availability can't be confirmed from here.
